title: Draw the spectrogram of a tone sweep
brief: Synthesise a one-second sweep, cut it into windowed frames, and track its pitch through a spectrogram you compute with numpy.
hints: The phase of a linear sweep is 2 pi (f0 t + (f1 - f0) t^2 / (2 T)). Its derivative over 2 pi is the frequency at time t.
Build the frame indices as np.arange(frame_length)[None, :] + hop * np.arange(n_frames)[:, None], then index the signal once.
np.fft.rfft(frames * window, axis=1) gives one row per frame; transpose it so rows are frequencies.
